why_not_one_block_off: Not a street: the seam between the wharf plate and sheet 11 is placed at the column where sheet 11 stops drawing (its bay-side blank band, 1250 native px), so sheet 11 owns everything it maps at 50 ft/in and the 100 ft/in wharf plate supplies only the piers and bay beyond. The panel-side coordinate is the same mosaic column through the frozen sheet-5 transform.
